title: Night audit, ii
logline: The key week. 2 AM. A guest wants ice. The machine's hum stops while it drops the ice and the line under the panel stops with it.

panels.composition: The desk. WOOD. A GUEST in a bathrobe, hair flat on one side, holding an empty ice bucket. The hum line beneath.

image.prompt: a motel night desk with a clerk in a maroon polo and a guest in a white bathrobe with hair flat on one side holding an empty ice bucket, razor-sharp ink, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: The ice machine down the hall. The two of them waiting in front of it. Its hum drawn as the line. Then —

image.prompt: two men standing side by side in a motel hallway waiting in front of an ice machine, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: The ice drops. KRRSSHH. The line under the panel is broken — a gap under the crash.

image.prompt: close-up of ice cascading inside a motel ice machine, a flat line beneath the panel broken by a gap
image.notes: The hum line has a gap exactly under the ice drop. The only time in the run the line breaks.

panels.composition: The guest walking away with a full bucket. Wood back at the desk. The line resumed, unbroken.

image.prompt: a guest in a bathrobe walking away down a hall with a full ice bucket while a clerk returns to a desk, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The hum line breaks for the ice drop. Once.
